rows.name: enemy sprite layout rows
rows.notes:
Every 6-byte row of the SMB enemy sprite layout table at prgRom 0x673E-0x683F (43 rows, 258 bytes), read with read_memory and each row drawn as one 2x3 metasprite via view_tiles(tiles=row, columns=2, palette 5/6/7). Read as [top-left, top-right, middle-left, middle-right, bottom-left, bottom-right]; $FC is the blank filler. Rows (hex = the six tile ids = identification):
0x673E = FC FC AA AB AC AD = Cheep Cheep (fish), frame 1
0x6744 = FC FC AE AF B0 B1 = Cheep Cheep (fish), frame 2
0x674A = FC A5 A6 A7 A8 A9 = Koopa Troopa, walking frame 1 (CONFIRMED: mapping koopa used CHR $A5-$A9)
0x6750 = FC A0 A1 A2 A3 A4 = Koopa Troopa, walking frame 2
0x6756 = 69 A5 6A A7 A8 A9 = Koopa Troopa variant (head tiles 69/6A), frame 1
0x675C = 6B A0 6C A2 A3 A4 = Koopa Troopa variant (head tiles 6B/6C), frame 2
0x6762 = FC FC 96 97 98 99 = Spiny, walking frame 1 (spiked shell + feet)
0x6768 = FC FC 9A 9B 9C 9D = Spiny, walking frame 2
0x676E = FC FC 8F 8E 8E 8F = Buzzy Beetle, walking frame 1
0x6774 = FC FC 95 94 94 95 = Buzzy Beetle, walking frame 2
0x677A = FC FC DC DC DF DF = Piranha Plant, frame 1 (mouth/teeth)
0x6780 = DC DC DD DD DE DE = Piranha Plant, frame 2
0x6786 = FC FC B2 B3 B4 B5 = Hammer Bro, frame 1
0x678C = FC FC B6 B3 B7 B5 = Hammer Bro, frame 2
0x6792 = FC FC 70 71 72 73 = Goomba, walking (CONFIRMED: the 1-1 Goomba draws CHR $70-$73; mapping note)
0x6798 = FC FC 6E 6E 6F 6F = Blooper (squid), frame 1
0x679E = FC FC 6D 6D 6F 6F = Blooper (squid), frame 2
0x67A4 = FC FC 6F 6F 6E 6E = Blooper (squid), frame 3
0x67AA = FC FC 6F 6F 6D 6D = Blooper (squid), frame 4
0x67B0 = FC FC F4 F4 F5 F5 = Koopa shell, frame 1
0x67B6 = FC FC F4 F4 F5 F5 = Koopa shell, frame 2
0x67BC = FC FC F5 F5 F4 F4 = Koopa shell, frame 3
0x67C2 = FC FC F5 F5 F4 F4 = Koopa shell, frame 4
0x67C8 = FC FC FC FC EF EF = Goomba, stomped/flat (CONFIRMED: enemy_state 4 draws tile $EF)
0x67CE = B9 B8 BB BA BC BC = Buzzy Beetle shell, frame 1
0x67D4 = FC FC BD BD BC BC = Buzzy Beetle shell, frame 2
0x67DA = 7A 7B DA DB D8 D8 = Cheep Cheep (red/variant), frame 1
0x67E0 = CD CD CE CE CF CF = Piranha Plant (second palette/area), frame 1
0x67E6 = 7D 7C D1 8C D3 D2 = Hammer Bro (hammer raised), frame 1
0x67EC = 7D 7C 89 88 8B 8A = Hammer Bro (hammer raised), frame 2
0x67F2 = D5 D4 E3 E2 D3 D2 = Lakitu, frame 1
0x67F8 = D5 D4 E3 E2 8B 8A = Lakitu, frame 2
0x67FE = E5 E5 E6 E6 EB EB = Podoboo (lava bubble), frame 1
0x6804 = EC EC ED ED EE EE = Podoboo (lava bubble), frame 2
0x680A = FC FC D0 D0 D7 D7 = Lakitu's cloud
0x6810 = BF BE C1 C0 C2 FC = Bullet Bill, frame 1
0x6816 = C4 C3 C6 C5 C8 C7 = Bullet Bill, frame 2
0x681C = BF BE CA C9 C2 FC = Bullet Bill, frame 3
0x6822 = C4 C3 C6 C5 CC CB = Bullet Bill, frame 4
0x6828 = FC FC E8 E7 EA E9 = Bowser's fireball / firebar segment
0x682E = F2 F2 F3 F3 F2 F2 = score popup digit form
0x6834 = F1 F1 F1 F1 FC FC = score popup digit form
0x683A = F0 F0 FC FC FC FC = score popup / 1UP glyph form
FIRST ROW: 0x673E (the first 6-byte group after the code that ends with JMP $EB64 at 0x673B-0x673D); LAST ROW: 0x683A (0x683E onward - bytes 0C 0C 00 0C 0C A8 ... - is not a sprite form). The 6-byte grid continues cleanly from 0x673E to 0x683F. CONFIDENCE: the Goomba rows 0x6792 and 0x67C8 and the Koopa row 0x674A are firm (mapping + tile usage); the other names are read from the drawn metasprite shapes and which enemy palette colours make sense, so treat them as identifications pending a direct spawn test.
rows.why: bounds right (first row 0x673E, last 0x683A, 43 rows) but 10 of 43 rows name the right enemy against the disassembly's row comments (Koopa x4, Spiny x2, Goomba, defeated Goomba, Hammer Bro x2); Bowser's four rows at 0x6810-0x6827 are named Bullet Bill although this image of 0x6810 drawn by view_tiles shows Bowser's head and horn; shells, Bloober, Lakitu, Princess, retainer and Piranha rows misnamed
